This place fixes a bad travel day.

Ocean Night Bar on Võ Thị Sáu is a bar and grill sitting at the edge of Phu Quoc's coastline. 4.8 stars across 443 reviews. Grilled food, cold drinks, the ocean doing its thing at night.

No hustle. No upsell. Just the kind of evening you came here for.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
